title: Enforce independent two-stage review gates
objective: Enforce independent two-stage review gates. Implement only this observable slice using the frozen schema and port contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Require separate higher-capability R1/R2 invocations and every applicable checklist item with evidence
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-020 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Restart validation and both reviews after material R2 fixes and reject stale mismatched reports
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-020 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

output_contracts: reviews/gates public behavior described by this task acceptance; use predeclared ports
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
Public interface/dependency notes, deviations and risks
